source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool Test procedure: 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Error Reporting: True c. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Operation Mode: Programmable Mode d. UMC Common Options → DDR PMIC Configuration → PMIC Fault Recovery: Always e. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → Release SPD Host Control: Disabled f. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → PMFW Poll DDR5 Telemetry: Disabled g. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 0 Enable: I2C Enabled h. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 1 Enable: I2C Enabled i. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 2 Enable: I2C Enabled j. FCH Common Options → I3C/I2C Configuration Options → I3C/I2C 3 Enable: I2C Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listvalidumc 6. Fatal error injection: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --einjpmicerrors --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --railtype 10 --voltagetype 0 --dimm 0 7.Repeat step 1 to step 6 for all DIMMs with different voltagetype as 0/1. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- High Current Consumption Warning: inject the DDR PMIC High Current Consumption Warning via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'PMIC|power.good|critical|over.current|over.voltage|switchover|temperature|current.limit'; echo __DDR_PMIC_High_Current_Consumption_Warning; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.test_name: High Current Consumption Warning — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Inject a PMIC high-current-consumption warning for every approved DIMM and voltage type, verify the intended correctable warning and OS reporting, and show that current, rail, thermal and memory health return to baseline without protection action.
required_package: PMIC/tool proof railtype10 selects High Current Consumption Warning and definitions of voltagetype0/1
Warning threshold, duration, hysteresis, latch/clear behavior, correctable/fatal semantics and reset/no-reset policy
Per-DIMM/PMIC socket/die/UMC/channel/slot/dimm, rail and calibrated current-sensor map
Wistron BMC/platform I2C controller/bus/address/OOB path and raw warning/status registers
Command continuation and full target tuple matrix
Normal/warning/limiter/trip current boundaries, thermal/voltage limits, fresh PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence, timeout and restoration
test_case.test_command: Prove railtype10 and parameter semantics; map each DIMM/PMIC/current sensor/I2C path; baseline current, voltage, temperature and warning state; inject one approved tuple; correlate calibrated current and fresh PMIC/CPER/SEL evidence; confirm warning-only behavior, clear timing and no limiter/reset; restore and validate memory before the next target.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
